routing_only.description: Non-Amazon routing namespace; recipe projectors set this internally.

allow_cleartext_bearer.description: Explicit opt-in for the shared API Bearer credential on cleartext SIP UDP/TCP; use only on a separately restricted private or carrier network

udp_port_range.description: Inclusive bounded ICE/media UDP range shared by browser and Amazon Connect peers.

audio_codecs.description: Primary codecs registered by the public WebRTC edge. Opus-only is the deterministic browser default.

destination.description: Typed server-owned RequestedLeg; Bridgefu performs strict semantic validation

bearer_token.description: Rejected by Bridgefu 1.0; generic signaling shares api.bearer_token

twilio.description: Deferred beyond Bridgefu 1.0; retained only for configuration migration diagnostics
